headings.style: Elegant, display serif, atmospheric. High contrast. tracking-tighter.

visual_enhancers.shadows: Ambient glows using primary/accent colors with low opacity for hover states.
visual_enhancers.borders: 1px solid border-white/10 on cards and layout containers.
visual_enhancers.glassmorphism: backdrop-blur-xl with bg-black/60 for sticky navs, overlays, and floating cards. No raw transparent backgrounds over content.

layouts.spacing: Generous spacing. py-24 to py-32 for sections. gap-8 to gap-12 for grids. Avoid tight layouts.
layouts.bento_grid: Use Mode A (Tetris grid) for the Offerings and Gallery. Asymmetrical span logic (col-span-8, col-span-4).
layouts.hero: Max overlay bg-black/50. If text contrast is needed, use a gradient to transparent rather than full blanket overlay.

motion.animations: Framer motion for staggered fade-ins on scroll. Subtle scale up and border glow on card hover.

UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Never use generic centered layouts. Use asymmetrical grids.
Do not use transparent header; always use glassmorphism with blur and background opacity.
Do not invent facts (awards, prices, menu items). Use only provided facts in content_facts.
Ensure minimum WCAG AA contrast for text over images using text shadow or gradient overlays.
Add 'data-testid' to all interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs).
Do NOT apply 'transition: all' in CSS.
Do NOT center align the app container in App.css.
Include hover states and micro-animations for every interactive element.
Build as a frontend-only React SPA marketing site using standard HTML/Tailwind for layout (do not rely on Shadcn layout wrappers for landing page creativity).
